_: Hunter line sheet + casting (L18 COPY rewrite of L10's sheet; same structure). <= 8 words per line, 4 lines per hunter x VOICE_EVENT. Variant 1 of every 'back' pool is the Crypt-was-a-lie line for the kill beat. Render: bun audio/render-voices.ts say|openai

openai.instructions: A tired professional exorcist, thirty years in the trade, on a job he has done a thousand times. Low, unhurried and flat, like a plumber explaining the boiler. Dry, a little bored, never shouts; the menace is that he is not worried at all.

A theatrical, sincere spirit medium who believes everything. Breathy and warm, calls everyone darling, little gasps on discovery, genuinely hurt when lied to and instantly over it. Sweet with an unsettling edge, like a favourite aunt who talks to the dead.
A deadpan, petty scientist keeping score. Flat, quick and precise, almost no inflection, a tiny pause before the dig. Unimpressed, faintly smug, never raises their voice.
A vain, operatic priest who adores his own voice. Grand, rolling and slow, savours every word as if a choir is behind him, pauses for applause that never comes. Self-pity delivered as scripture.

arrive: Lovely house. Shame about the residents.
I was told this place was empty.
Six rooms. Let's not make this weird.
sweep: Checking this one. Stay behind me.
Nobody breathe. Not that you can.
caught: One down. Put it on the board.
Got one. Don't make a fuss.
fooled: We took directions from a dead person.
Who listened to the ghost? Medium.
That was a lie. A good one.
possessed: That room's theirs now. Take it back.
Lost one. Nobody tell my boss.
They're putting up curtains in there.
back: ...the Crypt was a lie, wasn't it.
The house died. Of course you didn't.
win: House is clean. I'm going home.
lose: It's their house now. I'm too old.
taunt: Come out. I'm paid by the hour.
Hide well. I get paid either way.
I've been doing this since before phones.

arrive: Hello, darlings. I can feel your phones.
Ooh. It's so crowded in here.
Spirits, one at a time, please.
sweep: I'm opening my third eye. Now!
Out you come! Into the light!
caught: Oh! I felt that one go.
Got you! I mean... be at peace.
Goodbye, darling. Write if you can.
missed: But they were here. I felt them!
Empty? My elbows were so sure.
Hmm. The vibes were very strong.
fooled: A ghost lied to me? A ghost?
I trusted you. I trusted all of you.
possessed: They've taken the room! I feel faint.
The room is humming! I love it!
It's beautiful. It's terrible. I need water.
back: The Crypt was a lie? They promised!
Did we die? I felt us die.
I saw a white light. Then static.
Everyone's back! I knew they'd wait.
win: Go into the light, darlings. Go on.
It's so quiet. I miss them already.
They've crossed over. I'm going to cry.
lose: They want us to leave. Politely, for now.
I should have read the tea leaves.
They're in the walls. And in me.
I'm staying. No, I'm not. Run.
taunt: I can feel your little phone buzzing.
Whisper to me. I'll believe anything.
Tell me where you are. I won't tell.

arrive: For the record, this is a draft.
Ghosts aren't real. I'll catch them anyway.
I brought a clipboard. She brought candles.
sweep: Searching. Try not to be measurable.
caught: That's one for me. I'm counting.
One subject removed. Peer review pending.
missed: Empty. That was the Medium's pick.
Nothing. Put that one on her.
fooled: We trusted a ghost. Write that down.
Who could have predicted this? Me.
I'd like it minuted that I objected.
possessed: That room is theirs now. Legally, somehow.
back: The server died. The data didn't.
Everything came back exactly where it was.
win: House cleared. Ghosts still aren't real.
Case closed. I'm keeping the clipboard.
The numbers never lie. Ghosts do.
lose: This was not in the model.
taunt: Your battery is at twelve percent.
I know which room you picked.

arrive: Fear not. I'm here. Also, hello.
Bless this house. Especially the lighting.
I polished my cross for this.
sweep: The light compels you! My light.
Out! I'm told my voice carries.
caught: Rest in peace. Remember my face.
missed: Nobody? I did my good side for nothing.
A test of faith. How tedious.
fooled: Deceived! By the dead, no less!
This is the Medium's fault. Somehow.
Lied to. In my good robe.
possessed: That room needs a priest. Luckily.
back: The Crypt was a lie! Heresy!
Was that the rapture? Why am I here?
win: Hallelujah. And yes, it was me.
The house is purified. Applause welcome.
lose: Abandon the house! Save my hair!
I shall pray for you. Later.
This is not my good side!
I was never here. Tell no one.
taunt: Come into the light. Mind the robe.
I see you. I see everything. Mostly me.
